cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Hand It Over
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to give up control of a task, object, or decision you believe is being mishandled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the seating-plan pencil. I taught you to host, and you've put the exes beside each other.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you noticed the improvement. I haven't yet taught you the difference between civil and trapped. Let me separate their places.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spent hours getting the table numbers even.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you finally got the arithmetic right. I'll keep every total; you read me the numbers while I move the names.
